name: a call outside a task context degrades, it does not fabricate
why: §5.9: the task boundary is marked once and instrumentation is automatic — so a call that happens *outside* any task context is a real, common case. The SDK must let it through unenriched and must not invent a credential to fill the hole: a fabricated assertion would put a claim nobody made into the evidence. Unlike case 04 this is SDK-expressible, and an SDK driver must exercise it through its own public surface (a call outside @gurdy.task), not by bypassing itself.
